note: tip_height is the Gate index-url tip clock, read fresh at receipt, bypassing the local mirror. A failed or stale read is not read and the state is held. A stale read is a tip answer not fetched from index-url for this receipt or retry: the local mirror, a cache, or an earlier read. With several index sources every source is read. Any failed or stale source read makes the tip not read. Otherwise the highest tip is used. The check is decided once per client submission, at the first successful tip read. Held retries and service-started re-verifies reuse it. A policy-version bump never revokes on it. A client resubmission is a new receipt. A lower tip after a reorg does not reopen a refuse. last_beacon_height is last_interrupt_height. tip_height minus last_beacon_height greater than K refuses. K is policy. A placeholder of 3 is placeholder, not ratified. A gap of 3 is not refused by this rule. A gap of 4 refuses as submission_deadline and is not a fake leg. When tip_height is below last_beacon_height the state is held.
